quarterly_data.quarter: Constellation Energy press release: Google and Constellation Announce Landmark Agreement to (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nuclear uprate program backed by the new Google agreement: the 20-year power purchase agreement will enable investments in new equipment and technology (turbines, steam generators, digital control systems) at 11 Constellation-owned nuclear units across six nuclear sites in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey, adding 890 MW of new nuclear capacity to the PJM grid, with the first uprate expected to be delivered by 2028. The release says the capacity is entirely new and represents more than $4.3 billion of new investment by Constellation (roughly 4,400 existing jobs sustained, approximately 7,200 new construction jobs). The agreement also incorporates operational load-shaping and demand-response capabilities to curtail non-critical power consumption during high-stress grid events. CEO Joe Dominguez: the collaboration 'can serve as a model for how technology companies and the energy industry can work together'.
quarterly_data.figure: 890 MW new nuclear capacity at 11 units (six sites); more than $4.3 billion of new investment; first uprate expected by 2028

quarterly_data.quarter: Constellation Energy press release: Google and Constellation Announce Landmark Agreement to (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Constellation selected Google Cloud and Gemini Enterprise under an expanded five-year technology alliance to build an 'AI for energy' blueprint: Gemini Enterprise agentic workflows built into its core operations, with three initial focus areas - speed to power (site selection, power flow modeling, permitting and interconnection planning for uprates), generation optimization (asset health monitoring, outage and turnaround management) and protecting critical infrastructure (Google Cloud platforms used to secure operational technology networks).
quarterly_data.figure: five-year technology alliance; three initial focus areas

contracts.source: Constellation Energy press release: Google and Constellation Announce Landmark Agreement to (10-06-2026)
contracts.signal: Google and Constellation announced a 20-year power purchase agreement to bring 890 MW of new nuclear capacity onto the PJM grid through uprates at 11 Constellation-owned nuclear units in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey (first uprate expected by 2028), and a 15-year energy supply agreement for an additional 2,700 MWs of Constellation's PJM fleet that ensures existing assets remain economically viable. The companies also agreed a strategic framework to evaluate new clean generation, storage and demand response opportunities across the United States to support Google's growth, prioritizing near-term efforts in PJM. Google (Amanda Peterson Corio, global head of energy and power): the agreement is to fund nuclear reactor uprates.
contracts.units: 890 MW (20-year PPA); 2,700 MWs (15-year energy supply agreement)
